import sys

def document_analyser(doc):
    state = "OUTSIDE"
    last_was_letter = False
    longest = 0
    cur_len = 0
    words = 0

    for c in doc:
        if c == '(':
            state = "INSIDE"
            last_was_letter = False
            cur_len = 0
        elif c == ')':
            state = "OUTSIDE"
            last_was_letter = False
            cur_len = 0
        else:
            if c.isalpha():
                if state == "INSIDE" and not last_was_letter:
                    words += 1
                elif state == "OUTSIDE":
                    cur_len += 1
                    if cur_len > longest:
                        longest = cur_len
                last_was_letter = True
            else:
                last_was_letter = False
                cur_len = 0

    return [longest, words]

def main():
    tokens = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not tokens:
        return
    length = int(tokens[0])
    data = tokens[1] if len(tokens) > 1 else ""
    result = document_analyser(data)
    print(f"{result[0]} {result[1]}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
